title: CI/CD pipeline and release gates

acceptance_gates.description: The pipeline implements the v1.2 gate order through image build, including secret scanning and dependency, container and IaC scanning.
Images are immutable digests with an SBOM, and Temporal workflow replay runs as a merge gate.
Zero unwaived Critical or High findings on the release candidate.
